Design principles

design.Rmd

Scope

Reading .npy and .npz files in R.

Writing is out of scope. When working across multiple languages, one should prefer high-performance interoperable format (parquet, zarr, etc.).

FAQ

Why not use reticulate?

Why is this package slow?

This package is optimized for performance as much as base R allows. We could get better performance by using a lower-level language under the hood, but this package only exist as a crutch if you have received a .npy or .npz file and want to read it in R.

For better performance when exchanging data across languages, one should prefer high-performance interoperable format (parquet, zarr, etc.).
